text.en:
Creation. - The Bicol CARE Commission (B CARE C)
is hereby created.

Mandate. - The B CARE C shall integrate relief.
rehabilitation, resettlement, recovery, livelihood and development efforts
in the different areas of the Bicol Region particularly affected by
typhoons Caloy. Milenvo, and Reming. 'It shall likewise ensure that
public funds allocated for victims of said disasters shall be spent
judiciously and effectively through efficient prioritization of programs and
consistent monitoring of projects. It shall replace NDCC as the clearing
house for all claims/requests. Upon consolidation /evaluation, it shall
approve the appropriate requests. It shall notify the DBM of its approval
as a basis for the release of the fund.

Powers. - The B CARE C shall have the following
a. To generate proposals from the implementing agencies for relief.
rehabilitation, resettlement recovery.
livelihood and
development efforts as well as infrastructure support
b. To work with the Departent of Environment and Natural
Resources (DENR) on hazard mapping for the Bicol Region;
c. To work with the Bicol River Basin and Watershed Management
Project Management Office on common or overlapping project
activities:
d. To regulariy monitor the status of programs, projects and
activities in the areas devastated by typhoons Caloy, Milenvo,
Reming and Senyang in the Bicol Region to ensure their prompt
and efficient execution;
e. To recommend courses of action to ensure cobesiveness in
objectives and coordinated action to imorove the

Reportorial Requirements. - The B CARE C shall
submit to the appropriate Congressional oversight committee a quarterly
report on the funds allocated indicating the amount released, obligated
and disbursed for:
a. Aid, relief, resettlement, rehabilitation and livelihood services:
b. Construction or repair and reconstruction of infrastructure
projects being Gnanced, and the accomplishments for the
expended appropriations.

Term. - The B CARE C shall exercise its powers and
functions for a period of two (2) years unless otherwise directed by the

Funding. - The funding for the administrative and
operational expenses of the B CARE C shall be sourced from the
Calamity Fund.

Repealing Clause. -
All other executive issuances.
rules and regulations on parts thereof that are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect
